question: What is the Laplace transform of e^(-2t) u(t)?
solution: L{e^(-at)} = 1/(s + a), so with a = 2 the transform is 1/(s + 2). Topic (Laplace transforms) is in the Engineering Mathematics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
